description: This file contains utility functions for formatting and styling output in a terminal environment, including colorizing text based on themes, padding, truncating strings, and formatting key-value pairs.

methods.name: isRich
methods.description: Determines whether the output should be styled with colors and rich formatting, based on terminal capabilities and options.

methods.name: pad
methods.description: Pads a string to a specified size for alignment.

methods.name: formatKey
methods.description: Colorizes a key string based on theme for rich output.

methods.name: formatValue
methods.description: Colorizes a value string based on theme for rich output.

methods.name: formatKeyValue
methods.description: Formats a key-value pair with optional colorization.

methods.name: formatSeparator
methods.description: Creates a separator string with styling.

methods.name: formatTag
methods.description: Styles a tag string based on its value and prefix.

methods.name: truncate
methods.description: Shortens a string to a maximum length, adding ellipsis if needed.

ctags.name: formatKey
ctags.pattern: /^export const formatKey = (key: string, rich: boolean) => colorize(rich, theme.warn, key);$/

ctags.name: formatValue
ctags.pattern: /^export const formatValue = (value: string, rich: boolean) => colorize(rich, theme.info, value);$/

ctags.name: isRich
ctags.pattern: /^export const isRich = (opts?: { json?: boolean; plain?: boolean }) =>$/

ctags.name: pad
ctags.pattern: /^export const pad = (value: string, size: number) => value.padEnd(size);$/
